name: SaaS ARR
definition: Annualized recurring revenue at the end of the most recent complete quarter, FX-adjusted to CAD.
formula: Total MRR x 12 (FX-adjusted)
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Quarter-exit value. Uses last month of quarter. FX via revenue.fx_rates JOIN.

name: Net New ARR
definition: Sum of monthly net new MRR within a quarter, annualized. Shows quarterly growth/contraction in recurring revenue.
formula: SUM(monthly Net New MRR) x 12, where Net New MRR = New MRR + Expansion + Downgrades + Cancellations
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Only includes complete quarters (3 months). Partial quarters excluded. Downgrades and cancellations are negative.

name: Pre-FX Gross ARR %
definition: Quarterly average Gross Revenue Retention rate, pre-FX. Measures revenue retained from existing customers excluding growth.
formula: Avg of monthly (Start MRR - Cancellations - Downgrades) / Start MRR across 3 months of the quarter
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)
notes: Benchmark: 85-90+%. Groups by EntityRecordID. Uses SUM(SaaSAmount) with no filters.

name: Pre-FX NRR %
definition: Quarterly average Net Revenue Retention rate, pre-FX. Measures revenue retained from existing customers including growth.
formula: Avg of monthly (Start MRR - Cancellations - Downgrades + Expansions) / Start MRR across 3 months
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)
notes: Benchmark: 100+%. Exact match for Feb '26: 96.33%. Groups by EntityRecordID.

name: Cumulative ACV
definition: Running total of all new Annual Contract Value booked since the start of tracking, at quarter end.
formula: Running SUM(New MRR x 12) from first month through quarter end
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Computed client-side from monthlyData. Only includes complete quarters.

name: Paying Logos
definition: Count of distinct entities with non-zero SaaSAmount in a given month, at quarter end.
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT EntityRecordID) WHERE SaaSAmount != 0
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: End-of-quarter snapshot. Uses EntityRecordID grouping.

name: S&M:Net New ARR
definition: Sales & Marketing spend divided by Net New ARR. Efficiency metric for growth investment.
formula: S&M Spend / Net New ARR
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Blocked: requires P&L data (S&M line items) not yet in BigQuery. Benchmark: <1.5.

name: S&M:New ARR
definition: Sales & Marketing spend divided by New ARR only (excludes expansion). Customer acquisition efficiency.
formula: S&M Spend / New ARR
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Blocked: requires P&L data. Benchmark: <1.0.

name: Rule of 40
definition: Combined YoY revenue growth rate plus EBITDA margin. SaaS health benchmark.
formula: YoY ARR Growth % + EBITDA Margin %
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Blocked: requires P&L data for EBITDA. Benchmark: 35-40%.

name: Rev / Emp
definition: Annualized quarterly revenue divided by headcount. Revenue efficiency per employee.
formula: (Qtr Total Revenue / 3) x 12 / Headcount
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Blocked: requires headcount data. Benchmark: $125-135k.

name: Cost / Emp
definition: Annualized quarterly operating cost divided by headcount.
formula: (Qtr Total OpEx / 3) x 12 / Headcount
source_table: P&L data + headcount data (not in BQ)
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Blocked: requires P&L + headcount data.

name: Gross Margin %
definition: Gross profit as a percentage of revenue.
formula: (Revenue - COGS) / Revenue x 100
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Blocked: requires P&L data (COGS line items).

name: Operating Exp %
definition: Operating expenses as a percentage of revenue.
formula: OpEx / Revenue x 100
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Blocked: requires P&L data.

name: Total MRR (FX-adjusted)
definition: Monthly Recurring Revenue for all paying entities, converted to CAD using monthly OFX USD/CAD rates.
formula: SUM(entity SaaSAmount x FX rate) where US entities get avg_rate from fx_rates, CAN entities get 1.0
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Currency detection: most recent Income transaction with US-Sales or CAN-Sales in AccountFullName.

name: Total ARR (FX-adjusted)
definition: Annualized MRR. Simply Total MRR multiplied by 12.
formula: Total MRR x 12
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Derived from totalMRR in the same query.

name: New MRR (FX-adjusted)
definition: Monthly revenue from brand-new paying entities (first month with SaaSAmount > 0), FX-adjusted.
formula: SUM(cur_mrr x FX rate) WHERE prev_mrr = 0 AND cur_mrr > 0
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Entity had zero revenue in prior month, non-zero in current month.

name: Expansion MRR (FX-adjusted)
definition: Monthly revenue increase from existing entities that grew their spend, FX-adjusted.
formula: SUM((cur_mrr - prev_mrr) x FX rate) WHERE prev_mrr > 0 AND cur_mrr > prev_mrr
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Positive value. Only includes entities that increased.

name: Downgrade MRR (FX-adjusted)
definition: Monthly revenue decrease from existing entities that reduced their spend but didn't cancel, FX-adjusted.
formula: SUM(-(prev_mrr - cur_mrr) x FX rate) WHERE prev_mrr > 0 AND cur_mrr > 0 AND cur_mrr < prev_mrr
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Stored as negative number. Entity still active, just paying less.

name: Cancellation MRR (FX-adjusted)
definition: Monthly revenue lost from entities that dropped to zero, FX-adjusted.
formula: SUM(-(prev_mrr x FX rate)) WHERE prev_mrr > 0 AND cur_mrr = 0
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Stored as negative number. Entity had revenue last month, zero this month.

name: Net New MRR
definition: Monthly net change in recurring revenue from all movement types.
formula: New MRR + Expansion + Downgrades + Cancellations (downgrades and cancellations are already negative)
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Positive = net growth. Negative = net contraction.

name: Net New ARR (Monthly)
definition: Net New MRR annualized for the MRR Metrics table.
formula: Net New MRR x 12
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Different from the quarterly Net New ARR in KPI Summary.

name: USD/CAD FX Rate
definition: Monthly average OFX exchange rate for converting US entity revenue to CAD.
formula: Stored value from revenue.fx_rates table
source_of_truth: OFX monthly averages (confirm which source matches the KPI deck)
notes: FX rates table created but may not be fully populated. March 2026 estimate: 1.3700.

name: FX Change on ARR
definition: Impact of revaluing US-denominated revenue at the new month's FX rate.
formula: ARR Start (current month) - ARR Exit (prior month)
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Captures the FX revaluation effect. First month always 0.

name: ARR Start
definition: Beginning-of-month ARR position after FX revaluation.
formula: ARR Exit - Net New ARR - (Other MRR x 12)
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Equivalent to prior month ARR Exit + FX Change on ARR.

name: Other MRR
definition: Residual MRR not explained by new/expansion/downgrade/churn. Primarily prepaid expiry transitions.
formula: Total MRR - (prior Total MRR + Net New MRR)
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Captures expired prepaid SaaS transitioning from unearned to earned revenue.

name: ARR Exit
definition: End-of-month annualized recurring revenue.
formula: Total MRR x 12
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Same as Total ARR for that month.

name: SaaS ARR (Monthly Chart)
definition: Monthly SaaS ARR trend (FX-adjusted) shown as a bar chart.
formula: Total MRR x 12 (from buildMonthlyMRRSQL)
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Bar chart with data labels showing ARR trend over time.

name: New MRR (Chart)
definition: Monthly new MRR bar chart showing revenue from first-time paying entities.
formula: SUM(cur_mrr x FX) WHERE prev_mrr = 0 AND cur_mrr > 0
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Separate chart from the MRR Metrics table; same underlying data.

name: Net New MRR (Chart)
definition: Monthly dual bar chart: New MRR vs Net New MRR side by side.
formula: New MRR and (New MRR + Expansion + Downgrades + Cancellations)
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Two bars per month. Net New MRR can be negative.

name: Net New ARR (Quarterly Chart)
definition: Quarterly bar chart of annualized net new recurring revenue.
formula: SUM(monthly Net New MRR within quarter) x 12
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Only complete quarters (3 months). Partial excluded.

name: NRR Components
definition: Stacked bar chart showing monthly new MRR, expansion, downgrades, and cancellations (FX-adjusted).
formula: Four bars per month: newMRR (positive), expansion (positive), downgrades (negative), churn (negative)
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Downgrades and cancellations stored as negative values from the query.

name: Monthly NRR % (Chart)
definition: Month-over-month net revenue retention rate shown as a bar chart.
formula: (Start MRR - Cancellations - Downgrades + Expansions) / Start MRR x 100
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)
notes: Pre-FX. Uses EntityRecordID grouping. Feb '26 = 96.33%.

name: Monthly GRR % (Chart)
definition: Month-over-month gross revenue retention rate shown as a bar chart.
formula: (Start MRR - Cancellations - Downgrades) / Start MRR x 100
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)

name: Annual NRR % (Chart)
definition: Year-over-year net revenue retention rate shown as a bar chart. Compares same month 12 months apart.
formula: (Start MRR - Cancellations - Downgrades + Expansions) / Start MRR x 100 (12-month comparison)
source_of_truth: Feb Annual.xlsx
notes: Within $41 for Feb '26 annual. Groups by EntityRecordID.

name: Annual GRR % (Chart)
definition: Year-over-year gross revenue retention rate shown as a bar chart.
formula: (Start MRR - Cancellations - Downgrades) / Start MRR x 100 (12-month comparison)
source_of_truth: Feb Annual.xlsx
notes: Annual pairs start from 2023-01 (comparing to 2022-01).

name: Cumulative ACV (Chart)
definition: Running total of new Annual Contract Value booked, shown as a bar chart.
formula: Running SUM(New MRR x 12) from start of data
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Computed as running sum in dashboard-client.tsx. Not independently validated against spreadsheet.

name: Paying Logos (Chart)
definition: Monthly count of distinct paying entities, shown as a bar chart.
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT EntityRecordID) WHERE SaaSAmount != 0 per month
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: EntityRecordID-level count. Looker uses CompanyAccount for customer counts, which may differ.

name: Enterprise % > $500/mth
definition: Percentage of paying entities with monthly SaaSAmount > $500.
formula: COUNTIF(saas_mrr > 500) / COUNT(DISTINCT EntityRecordID) x 100
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Pre-FX. Uses SaaSAmount threshold. EntityRecordID-level.

name: Enterprise % > 10 Licenses
definition: Percentage of paying entities with more than 10 licenses.
formula: COUNTIF(license_count > 10) / COUNT(DISTINCT EntityRecordID) x 100
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Uses MAX(LicenseCount) per entity per month.

name: NRR by Size — Small
definition: Quarterly NRR for entities with start-of-quarter MRR < $125, pre-FX.
formula: (Start MRR - Cancellations - Downgrades + Expansions) / Start MRR x 100 for Small bucket only
source_of_truth: Archived NRR by Segment Dashboard (Looker Studio)
notes: Compares first vs last month of quarter. Threshold: <$125. Pre-FX.

name: NRR by Size — Medium
definition: Quarterly NRR for entities with start-of-quarter MRR >= $125 and < $500, pre-FX.
formula: (Start MRR - Cancellations - Downgrades + Expansions) / Start MRR x 100 for Medium bucket only
source_of_truth: Archived NRR by Segment Dashboard (Looker Studio)
notes: Threshold: >= $125 and < $500.

name: NRR by Size — Large
definition: Quarterly NRR for entities with start-of-quarter MRR >= $500, pre-FX.
formula: (Start MRR - Cancellations - Downgrades + Expansions) / Start MRR x 100 for Large bucket only
source_of_truth: Archived NRR by Segment Dashboard (Looker Studio)
notes: Threshold: >= $500. Aligns with Enterprise Account Tracking.

name: Pre-FX Start MRR
definition: Beginning-of-month MRR for existing customers (entities with revenue in prior month), no FX adjustment.
formula: SUM(prev_mrr) across all entities with prev_mrr > 0
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)
notes: Feb '26 = $814,714. Exact match.

name: Pre-FX Cancellations
definition: Revenue lost from entities that dropped to $0, no FX adjustment.
formula: SUM(prev_mrr) WHERE prev_mrr > 0 AND cur_mrr = 0
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)
notes: Feb '26 = $28,025. Exact match.

name: Pre-FX Downgrades
definition: Revenue decrease from entities that shrank but didn't cancel, no FX adjustment.
formula: SUM(prev_mrr - cur_mrr) WHERE prev_mrr > 0 AND cur_mrr > 0 AND cur_mrr < prev_mrr
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)
notes: Feb '26 = $20,448. Exact match.

name: Pre-FX Churn
definition: Combined cancellations and downgrades, no FX adjustment.
formula: Cancellations + Downgrades
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)
notes: Sum of the two fields above.

name: Pre-FX Expansions
definition: Revenue increase from entities that grew, no FX adjustment.
formula: SUM(cur_mrr - prev_mrr) WHERE prev_mrr > 0 AND cur_mrr > prev_mrr
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)
notes: Feb '26 = $18,579. Exact match.

name: Pre-FX NRR (Monthly)
definition: Month-over-month Net Revenue Retention as a decimal (e.g. 0.9633).
formula: (Start MRR - Churn + Expansions) / Start MRR
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)

name: Pre-FX GRR (Monthly)
definition: Month-over-month Gross Revenue Retention as a decimal (e.g. 0.9405).
formula: (Start MRR - Churn) / Start MRR
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)

name: Downgrades (Chart)
definition: Monthly downgrade dollar amounts from Pre-FX data, shown as a bar chart.
formula: Same as Pre-FX Downgrades
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)
notes: Pre-FX values. Shows monthly churn composition.

name: Cancellations (Chart)
definition: Monthly cancellation dollar amounts from Pre-FX data.
formula: Same as Pre-FX Cancellations
source_of_truth: Feb Monthly.xlsx (NRR By Customer tab)
notes: Pre-FX values. Paired with downgrades chart.

name: MRR Trend (Chart)
definition: Monthly MRR trend shown as a bar chart (FX-adjusted).
formula: Total MRR from buildMonthlyMRRSQL
source_of_truth: USD Rates Board KPI Deck Preparation 2023+ (1).xlsx
notes: Shows Total MRR per month with data labels.
